data.one_liner: Add animated effects and builders in Flutter via a unified, customizable chainable API.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-built animations like fade, scale, slide, and blur that can be chained directly to any widget. Allows synchronizing animations to scroll, notifiers, or state changes without manually managing AnimationControllers.
use_when: You want to quickly add entrance or interaction animations to widgets with minimal boilerplate.
You need to coordinate multiple sequential or parallel effects using a clean shorthand syntax.
avoid_when: You need complex vector graphics animations where a dedicated engine like Rive or Lottie is more appropriate.
You require physics-based motion engines that heavily rely on interactive gesture simulations.
strengths: Intuitive chainable extension methods on all widgets.
Comprehensive collection of pre-built visual and layout effects.
Supports scroll and external adapters for advanced synchronization.
weaknesses: May require extra custom builders for highly intricate multi-property choreography.
Global effect reuse requires careful structuring to avoid unexpected shared state behaviors.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Lottie if you want to use complex, designer-crafted vector animations exported from After Effects.

alternatives.name: page_transition
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick page_transition if you specifically need route transition animations between different screens.
